answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil control by binding every identity to a bonded collateral escrow and correlating equivocation evidence. When k identities coordinate to sign conflicting states, aggregate slashing grows as O(k^2); once a managed swarm is detected, asymmetric depreciation applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss. A saffron label, a collateral ledge of lightly funded accounts, or a hollow identity trail therefore cannot cheaply increase voting power.
